name: Seir
source:
Age: XX | LV 10 Angel

Seir is the baby of the group. Perhaps not in age, but certainly in demeanor.

He is quite intelligent, despite his penchant for saying exactly what is on his mind. Still, his naivete is a charm point, and his heart is in the right place.

He's also the only angel in the crew and prefers to spend more time down in Stasis than up in Heaven. Supplies the group with Angelic Liquor.

LIKES
Sweets, reading romance novels, painting, playing chess, cooking for everyone, but Aina especially

DISLIKES
When Orias calls him an idiot, paperwork, work, not being able to see Aina, anyone who inconveniences Aina, housework

[From [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/KieranReganVA/status/1564489533185437696/]Twitter[/url]]
